says: Alice binds this device's key and the checkout and registers the repository's decisions source; Bob binds his own key on his own device. Alice selects records 12 to 18 of one session transcript for local processing and this repository only; the owner reads that span, the packaged local adapter captures a memory entry from it as a draft, and Alice stores a candidate choice from that capture, version 1, in her own private intake. She then prepares ordinary work in the repository (memory.use.prepare) with a reader envelope that requires the decisions source and selects her local candidate at version 1: the use is admitted and the result is delivered with the candidate, by id, version and digest, as support standing unadopted, apart from the source's units (none is published yet), together with the qualified state the use was admitted on. Local use is not narrowed to research because nothing was adopted. Using it establishes nothing shared: reading the candidate back afterwards (memory.candidate.read) returns version 1 still standing candidate, with no promotion and no receipt, and the current state of the concern resolved over the repository (memory.state.resolve) has no entry and reads the decisions source only at the head its registration committed. Bob preparing a use of his own that names Alice's candidate is answered denied with access_not_established: a candidate does not override whose it is, and naming it grants no reach.
